metric_definitions.physical_point_reach_rate: hidden final geodesic <= 0.75 m / forward attempts
metric_definitions.arrival_decision_accuracy: (TP + TN) / forward attempts against hidden 0.75 m label
metric_definitions.sub_instruction_completion_rate: ordered stages where the navigation system judged completed at an arrived node AND an independent post-run semantic audit verified actual completion / evaluated sub-instructions; missing audit evidence counts as not completed
metric_definitions.r2r_success_rate: complete instruction sequence executed and judged completed in order from episode start AND final goal radius reached; geometric-only hits are invalid and excluded
metric_definitions.simulator_reported_success_rate: explicit task-level STOP actions issued immediately after the final sub-instruction is judged completed, with the STOP pose inside the episode goal radius / episodes
metric_definitions.goal_radius_hit_diagnostic_count: diagnostic only; never reported as task success
metric_definitions.full_space_completion_rate: fraction with natural FIFO frontier-queue exhaustion and deterministic 3-D swept coverage of the full start-reachable navmesh island >= frozen threshold
